content.text: Section 18 fully satisfies the preferred position, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 contains a Vendor-side insurance covenant that meets or exceeds every element of our preferred position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, professional (E&O) at USD 2M, cyber and privacy liability at USD 5M (Vendor processes Customer Data under Sections 15 and 17), and workers' compensation as required by law, plus employer's liability of USD 1M as extra cover. Coverage runs through the term and for one year afterward, matching our model language. Section 18.2 supplies certificates and evidence of coverage on request, reputable insurers, notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities (so it does not undercut the Section 21 liability regime). The obligations bind the counterparty and benefit us; no edit is warranted.
